description: This file defines the QueryExecutor class responsible for executing data queries from various providers, including methods for retrieving providers and fetchers, filtering credentials, and executing asynchronous queries.

classes.name: QueryExecutor
classes.description: Class to execute queries from providers, managing provider retrieval, fetcher selection, credential filtering, and executing asynchronous data fetches.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the QueryExecutor with an optional registry or loads default extensions.

methods.name: get_provider
methods.description: Retrieves a provider object from the registry by name, raising an error if not found.

methods.name: get_fetcher
methods.description: Retrieves a fetcher object from a provider based on the model name, raising an error if not found.

methods.name: filter_credentials
methods.description: Filters and validates credentials against provider requirements, raising errors for missing credentials if required.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a query using specified provider, model, parameters, and credentials, returning the fetched data.
